args.title: Optimize error toasts for accessibility
args.body:
File: src/components/Toast.tsx

Modify the toast notification system to better handle error messages. Assign error toasts an aria-live value of "assertive" to ensure they are announced immediately by screen readers, unlike success and info messages. Implement a condition that prevents error messages from disappearing automatically after five seconds, ensuring they're visible until manually dismissed.

file: src/components/Toast.tsx
This comment was written by RepoMind, an automated triage agent. To reach a person, mention @ledgerline/maintainers.

The error toasts use the same polite live region as success messages, so screen readers delay their announcements. Additionally, they vanish after five seconds like other toasts. Modify the toast system to make error messages assertive and persistent until dismissed.
